facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Kissht parent OnEMI Technology Solutions shares rose 7.34% to ₹338.60 after the digital lender announced that assets under management had crossed ₹10,000 crore.
facts.text: Shares of OnEMI Technology Solutions climbed 7.34% to ₹338.60 on the stock exchanges following the announcement of its loan book milestone.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The portfolio remains weighted towards personal loans, which are unsecured and sourced entirely through digital channels. They stood at ₹8,580 crore, or 92.1% of AUM.
facts.text: Unsecured personal loans that fund retail consumer EMIs stood at ₹8,580 crore, making up 92.1% of the lender's total portfolio.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Cumulative customers served crossed 12.80 million, up 22% year on year.
facts.text: Cumulative household and retail borrowers served by the digital lender reached 12.80 million, rising 22% year-on-year.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Assets under management (AUM) grew 68% year on year to ₹9,317 crore, and profit after tax (PAT) doubled to ₹125 crore.
facts.text: OnEMI Technology Solutions reported a doubling of its quarterly profit after tax to ₹125 crore for the second quarter of FY27.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Loan against property, a secured product delivered through 107 branches across 9 states and union territories, stood at ₹737 crore, or 7.9%, and the company expects it to keep scaling through the remaining quarters of FY27 and beyond.
facts.text: Kissht expanded its secured loan against property portfolio for borrowing households to ₹737 crore across 107 physical branches.
